attempts.interpretation: Invalid narrow build setup for this source tree: shared conftest macros supplied by the nvidia Kbuild fragment were omitted. Its resulting API diagnostics are excluded from port conclusions.

root_causes: R595 uvm_parent_gpu_t lacks capability fields set by the R580 Volta initializer, including can_map_sysmem_with_large_pages, prefetch_fault_supported, gpfifo_in_vidmem_supported, replayable_faults_supported, non_replayable_faults_supported, fault_cancel_va_supported, scoped_atomics_supported, sparse_mappings_supported, and plc_supported.
R595 removed the tlb_batch.va_invalidate_supported and va_range_invalidate_supported flags used by the R580 initializer.
R580 uvm_hal_mmu_mode_volta calls uvm_hal_mmu_mode_pascal, which is absent from the R595 UVM HAL.
attempts.warnings: Volta HAL function declarations are also absent from the R595 header; the final build stopped before module link/modpost.

result: Source reuse is partial; the Volta UVM port is not drop-in and has no dispatch integration or runtime validation.
